makemeahanzi.definition: to retreat, to step back, to withdraw

characterDeckComponents.note: 辶 (to walk) — 退 relates to moving backward or away
艮 (gèn) gives a sound distantly related to 退's reading tuì, having drifted apart over time

makemeahanzi.definition: to risk, to brave, to dare

characterDeckComponents.note: 目 (eye) — 冒 originally described something extending over or covering, related to a covering over the head.
冃 (mào) is an exact match for the sound of 冒.

etymology.hint: A bird alighting on the ground 土

characterDeckComponents.note: 至 depicts an arrow reaching the ground after landing — arriving at a destination gave 至 its meaning 'to arrive' or 'until.'

makemeahanzi.definition: calm, composed; to control, to suppress

characterDeckComponents.note: 钅 (metal) — 镇 originally referred to a heavy metal weight used to press something down, later extending to 'garrison town.'
真 (zhēn) gives the sound — an exact match with 镇's reading zhèn, differing only in tone.
大 (big) — 奖 describes something given as a big reward.
丬 (qiáng) gives a sound close to jiǎng.
Bird — an older semantic root kept from an earlier character shape.
Gives the sound hù, related to gù but drifted apart over time.

meanings: (of an object or substance) to feel cold

characterDeckComponents.note: 冫 pictures ice crystals forming.
水 (water) sits beside it, together showing water turned to ice.

meanings: zero (unambiguous spoken form when spelling out numbers)

characterDeckComponents.note: 氵 (water) — 洞 originally described water hollowing out a cave or hole in rock.
同 (tóng) gives a sound distantly related to dòng, having drifted apart over time.

meanings: used in 蘭若|兰若[lan2 re3]

etymology.hint: Laws inscribed 刂 on a slate 贝

characterDeckComponents.note: 贝 (a shell, an ancient form of currency/valuables) — represents the property or standards that rules protect.
刂 (a knife) — depicts laws being carved or inscribed onto a slate, the source of 则's meaning 'rule, standard.'

makemeahanzi.definition: should, must; to respond, to handle; to deal with, to cope

characterDeckComponents.note: 饣 (food) — 饼 names a type of food, a flat cake.
并 (bìng) gives a sound close to bǐng, sharing the same rhyme with a different tone.

meanings: to get (or give) an electric shock
to send via telephone or telegram etc

etymology.hint: Simplified form of 電; lightning 申 from a storm cloud 雨

characterDeckComponents.note: 电 (simplified from 電) depicts a bolt of lightning — since lightning is a natural form of electricity, the character came to mean 'electricity.'

meanings: used in 鞦韆|秋千[qiu1 qian1]

makemeahanzi.definition: cotton, linen, textiles; to announce, to declare; to spread

etymology.hint: Cloth 巾 held in a hand

characterDeckComponents.note: 巾 (cloth) — held in a hand, the image behind 布's meaning 'cloth' and, by extension, 'to spread out, distribute.'

makemeahanzi.definition: a river in the Shanxi province; a city

characterDeckComponents.note: 氵 (water) — 洛 names a river.
各 (gè) gives a sound close to luò, sharing a related rhyme.

etymology.hint: A file of ten 十 people 亻

characterDeckComponents.note: 亻 (person) — 什 originally referred to a group of people.
十 (ten) — combined with 亻 (person), 什 originally described a group of ten; the character later came to be used for the common word 什么 (what).
Rice/grain — sugar was traditionally made from grains or cane.
Gives the sound táng, matching the character's reading.

etymology.hint: Older than 丨 the sun 日

characterDeckComponents.note: 丨 is a simple vertical stroke, a marker element in this character's form.
日 (sun, day) — 旧 relates to the passage of many days, giving it the meaning 'old, former.'
火 (fire) — linked to ritual fires once used to try to communicate with spirits
彐 (jì) gives a sound distantly related to 灵's reading líng, having drifted apart considerably over time

etymology.hint: Using a tool 殳 to sort items on a tray 舟

characterDeckComponents.note: 舟 (boat/tray) — represents a vessel or tray holding items.
殳 (a hand with a tool) — sorting or moving items on a tray gave 般 its meaning 'sort, kind, manner.'

meanings: to invert a container to empty it

makemeahanzi.definition: to accuse, to charge; to control; to sue

characterDeckComponents.note: 扌 (hand) — 控 relates to controlling or restraining something by hand
空 (kōng) gives the sound — an exact match with 控's reading kòng

makemeahanzi.definition: time, occasion; to make a journey

characterDeckComponents.note: 走 (walk) — 趟 describes making a trip on foot or in general.
尚 (shàng) gives a sound distantly related to tàng, having drifted apart over time.

makemeahanzi.definition: to show, to express, to display; outside, appearance; a watch

etymology.hint: Fur 毛 clothing 衣; a shawl or wrap

characterDeckComponents.note: 毛 (fur, hair) — 表 originally pictured a fur garment worn on the outside.
衣 (clothing) — an outer fur wrap gave 表 its meaning of 'outer' or 'surface,' and later, 'to express' (showing something on the surface).

makemeahanzi.definition: to surround; to besiege; surrounded, in distress; poor; tired, sleepy

etymology.hint: A fence 囗 built around a tree 木

characterDeckComponents.note: 囗 depicts an enclosure or fence.
木 (tree) — a tree hemmed in by a fence, unable to grow freely, gave 困 its meaning 'trapped, difficult.'
夭 depicts a person leaning to one side, arms swinging — here the pose of walking high up on stilts, giving 乔 its meaning 'tall, lofty.'

meanings: (literary) the outside world as distinct from oneself

characterDeckComponents.note: 牛 (ox/cattle) — cattle were among the earliest and most valuable kinds of property, connecting 物 to the general idea of 'object' or 'thing.'
勿 (wù) gives the sound — 物 is also pronounced wù, an exact match.
贝 (shell/money) — 货 relates to goods that are bought and sold for money
化 (huà) gives a sound distantly related to 货's reading huò, having drifted apart over time

meanings: to apply tung oil, paint or varnish

makemeahanzi.definition: oil, fat, grease, lard; oil paints

characterDeckComponents.note: 氵 (water) — 油 names an oily liquid.
由 (yóu) gives the sound — an exact match with 油.

meanings: (literary) to put a corpse on display (after execution)

characterDeckComponents.note: 尸 is traditionally read as a picture of a person collapsed or bent over — the origin of its meaning 'corpse.'

etymology.hint: A bear's 能 footprints 灬

characterDeckComponents.note: Depicts the body of a bear.
Shows the bear's four paws below its body.
亻 (person) — 值 relates to worth or value assigned by a person
直 (zhí) gives the sound — 值 is also pronounced zhí, an exact match

makemeahanzi.definition: to double; to increase or multiply
to clean, to erase, to polish; a brush

characterDeckComponents.note: Hand — wiping is an action done by hand.
Gives a sound distantly related to cā, having drifted apart over time.

meanings: (slang) to compete to an unhealthy degree

makemeahanzi.definition: book, scroll, volume; curled up; to curl, to roll

characterDeckComponents.note: 龹 pictures two hands working together.
㔾 depicts a person curled up, giving 卷 its meaning of rolling or curling something up.

makemeahanzi.definition: measure word for ships or vessels

characterDeckComponents.note: 舟 (boat) — 艘 is used to count boats and ships.
叟 (sǒu) gives a sound very close to sōu, sharing the initial and rhyme — only the tone differs.

etymology.hint: Two hands 八 holding one object 廾

characterDeckComponents.note: 八 (a hand shape) — one of two hands shown reaching toward the same object.
廾 (two hands together) — jointly holding up one object, giving 共 its meaning 'together, joint, common.'

makemeahanzi.definition: to stab; to prick, to irritate; to prod

characterDeckComponents.note: 刂 (knife) — 刺 describes the action of piercing or stabbing with something sharp.
朿 (cì) gives the sound — an exact match with 刺's reading cì.

makemeahanzi.definition: to boil, to fry, to roast, to sauté; to trade stock

characterDeckComponents.note: 火 (fire) — 炒 involves cooking with high heat.
少 (shǎo) gives a sound distantly related to chǎo, having drifted apart over time.

etymology.hint: A mouth 亼 talking about things

characterDeckComponents.note: 亼 — traditionally linked to an image of gathering or covering; its original pictorial sense has become obscure, but the character came to mean 'now, the present.'
⺼ (flesh) shows 脏 (zàng) relates to the body, as in internal organs.
庄 (zhuāng) gives a sound close to zàng, sharing a similar consonant sound though the vowel and ending differ.

makemeahanzi.definition: to combine, to join, to unite; to gather

etymology.hint: A person 大 riding a horse 可

characterDeckComponents.note: 大 (a person, arms outstretched) — represents a rider.
可 here is said to depict a mount — a person riding in an unusual way gave 奇 its meaning 'strange, odd, remarkable.'
口 (mouth) — the mouth radical, marking the character as related to speech, sound, or an action of the mouth.
米 (mǐ) gives a sound close to 咪's reading mī — the same syllable, differing only in tone.
纟 (silk/thread) — early paper was made from silk and plant fibers, linking 纸 to the thread radical.
氏 (shì) gives a sound distantly related to zhǐ, having drifted apart over time.

makemeahanzi.definition: balanced; name, brand; to say, to call

characterDeckComponents.note: 马 (horse) — 骑 describes riding on horseback.
奇 (qí) gives the sound — an exact match with 骑.

makemeahanzi.definition: to possess, to occupy; position; base

characterDeckComponents.note: 扌 (hand) — relates to 据's meaning 'to rely on, according to,' as if grasping evidence in hand.
居 (jū) gave the base sound; the pronunciation later shifted to jù, keeping the same final but a different tone.
辶 (walk/movement) — 迟 describes moving too slowly, arriving 'late.'
尺 (chǐ) gives a sound very close to chí, sharing the initial and rhyme — only the tone differs.
